task: Assess whether a confusing procurement delay establishes sabotage.
observed_facts: two status reports repeat the same supplier update
source_dependencies: two status reports derive from the same supplier update
next_collection: obtain supplier production logs and independent shipment tracking
premises: delay alone is compatible with multiple causes
dependent reports do not create independent corroboration
failed inspection is direct evidence of a quality problem but not intent
disconfirming_evidence: the failed component provides a mundane explanation for at least part of the delay
claimed_conclusion: Sabotage remains possible but is not established; mundane explanations remain viable and should be discriminated with further evidence.
